title: Assigned feature update policy reaches no managed Windows device

report.title: {Items.Count} assigned feature update {Plural(Items.Count, 'policy reaches', 'policies reach')} no managed Windows device

messages.businessImpact: The policy meant to hold Windows on a chosen release, or move it to one, reaches none of the managed estate, so devices take feature updates on whatever the update rings allow.
remediation: Check the assigned device groups and retarget the policy to the managed Windows devices it was written for, or delete it if it was superseded.
messages.cannotSee: User targeting, unread or mixed group membership and assignment filters can change reach, and those assignments are not judged until their effective targets are known. A policy assigned to nobody at all is UPD-021's question. Devices outside Intune are not counted.
